lens-performance-code finding 1: wrong — `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` writes `current_iter=N` BEFORE dispatch (required by DSITER-1): without it, an interruption mid-iter leaves `current_iter` at the previously-completed iteration's value, so resume starts one iteration too late. The two writes serve different purposes at distinct points (before dispatch vs after dispatch); they cannot be combined without reintroducing the resume-starts-at-wrong-iteration bug. The DSITER-1 write-side test (`[#1805/DSITER-1] current_iter=1 written to state before first cycle_dispatch_stage call`) explicitly enforces this ordering.
